title: Using AI for programming an indie game?
author: Positive_Cup5148
selftext: So I wanted to ask a question and see if this is a turn-off for people. Let’s say someone was to make a game, all the music, promotional art, writing, story, pixel art, animations, sound design, overall design, and all creative decisions were done by humans, but the programming was done by AI. Now when I say that I don’t mean the prompts were “make me a good menu system,” but instead a person told the AI the exact format they wanted and how every single detail should work. AI goes in, creates the code for a system like that, and a human goes in and makes all the tweaks and actually finalizes it themselves. Basically imagine a person of many talents has a great idea for a game they want, but just because they don’t know how to code they can’t make it. Would you guys be against playing a game where one person or a team did everything creatively with the game but used AI for programming assistance and programming only?
